| CC1101 | ESP32 | Function |
| --- | --- | --- |
| VCC | 3.3V | Power |
| GND | GND | Ground |
| SCK | GPIO18 | SPI clock: timing for the settings link |
| MOSI | GPIO23 | SPI data from the ESP32: frequency, power, send/listen |
| MISO (SO, GDO1) | GPIO19 | SPI data back to the ESP32: chip ID and status |
| CSN | GPIO25 | SPI chip select: low while the ESP32 talks to the chip |
| GDO0 | GPIO26 | Send data: 3.3 V turns the 433 MHz carrier on, 0 V off |
| GDO2 | GPIO27 | Receive data: 3.3 V while the chip hears a carrier |

The four SPI wires only carry settings; the remote codes travel over GDO0
(sending) and GDO2 (receiving) as plain on/off pulses. On some modules MISO
is labelled GDO1.

Make sure the module is the 433 MHz version (the longer spring antenna;
868 MHz modules are often marked 8xx) and that the antenna is soldered on.

| VCC | 3.3V | Power |
| GND | GND | Ground |
| SCK | GPIO18 | SPI clock: timing for the settings link |
| MOSI | GPIO23 | SPI data from the ESP32: frequency, power, send/listen |
| MISO (SO, GDO1) | GPIO19 | SPI data back to the ESP32: chip ID and status |
| CSN | GPIO25 | SPI chip select: low while the ESP32 talks to the chip |
| GDO0 | GPIO26 | Send data: 3.3 V turns the 433 MHz carrier on, 0 V off |
| GDO2 | GPIO27 | Receive data: 3.3 V while the chip hears a carrier |

The four SPI wires only carry settings; the remote codes travel over GDO0
(sending) and GDO2 (receiving) as plain on/off pulses. On some modules MISO
is labelled GDO1.

Make sure the module is the 433 MHz version (the longer spring antenna;
868 MHz modules are often marked 8xx) and that the antenna is soldered on.

| VCC | 3.3V | Power |
| GND | GND | Ground |
| SCK | GPIO18 | SPI clock: timing for the settings link |
| MOSI | GPIO23 | SPI data from the ESP32: frequency, power, send/listen |
| MISO (SO, GDO1) | GPIO19 | SPI data back to the ESP32: chip ID and status |
| CSN | GPIO25 | SPI chip select: low while the ESP32 talks to the chip |
| GDO0 | GPIO26 | Send data: 3.3 V turns the 433 MHz carrier on, 0 V off |
| GDO2 | GPIO27 | Receive data: 3.3 V while the chip hears a carrier |

The four SPI wires only carry settings; the remote codes travel over GDO0
(sending) and GDO2 (receiving) as plain on/off pulses. On some modules MISO
is labelled GDO1.

Make sure the module is the 433 MHz version (the longer spring antenna;
868 MHz modules are often marked 8xx) and that the antenna is soldered on.

| VCC | 3.3V | Power |
| GND | GND | Ground |
| SCK | GPIO18 | SPI clock: timing for the settings link |
| MOSI | GPIO23 | SPI data from the ESP32: frequency, power, send/listen |
| MISO (SO, GDO1) | GPIO19 | SPI data back to the ESP32: chip ID and status |
| CSN | GPIO25 | SPI chip select: low while the ESP32 talks to the chip |
| GDO0 | GPIO26 | Send data: 3.3 V turns the 433 MHz carrier on, 0 V off |
| GDO2 | GPIO27 | Receive data: 3.3 V while the chip hears a carrier |

The four SPI wires only carry settings; the remote codes travel over GDO0
(sending) and GDO2 (receiving) as plain on/off pulses. On some modules MISO
is labelled GDO1.

Make sure the module is the 433 MHz version (the longer spring antenna;
868 MHz modules are often marked 8xx) and that the antenna is soldered on.

| --- | --- | --- |
| VCC | 3.3V | Power |
| GND | GND | Ground |
| SCK | GPIO18 | SPI clock: timing for the settings link |
| MOSI | GPIO23 | SPI data from the ESP32: frequency, power, send/listen |
| MISO (SO, GDO1) | GPIO19 | SPI data back to the ESP32: chip ID and status |
| CSN | GPIO25 | SPI chip select: low while the ESP32 talks to the chip |
| GDO0 | GPIO26 | Send data: 3.3 V turns the 433 MHz carrier on, 0 V off |
| GDO2 | GPIO27 | Receive data: 3.3 V while the chip hears a carrier |

The four SPI wires only carry settings; the remote codes travel over GDO0
(sending) and GDO2 (receiving) as plain on/off pulses. On some modules MISO
is labelled GDO1.

Make sure the module is the 433 MHz version (the longer spring antenna;
868 MHz modules are often marked 8xx) and that the antenna is soldered on.

 | CC1101 | ESP32 | Function |

| GND | GND | Ground |

(sending) and GDO2 (receiving) as plain on/off pulses. On some modules MISO
is labelled GDO1.

Make sure the module is the 433 MHz version (the longer spring antenna;
868 MHz modules are often marked 8xx) and that the antenna is soldered on.

| GDO2 | GPIO27 | Receive data: 3.3 V while the chip hears a carrier |

The four SPI wires only carry settings; the remote codes travel over GDO0
(sending) and GDO2 (receiving) as plain on/off pulses. On some modules MISO
is labelled GDO1.

Make sure the module is the 433 MHz version (the longer spring antenna;
868 MHz modules are often marked 8xx) and that the antenna is soldered on.

| CSN | GPIO25 | SPI chip select: low while the ESP32 talks to the chip |
| GDO0 | GPIO26 | Send data: 3.3 V turns the 433 MHz carrier on, 0 V off |
| GDO2 | GPIO27 | Receive data: 3.3 V while the chip hears a carrier |

The four SPI wires only carry settings; the remote codes travel over GDO0
(sending) and GDO2 (receiving) as plain on/off pulses. On some modules MISO
is labelled GDO1.

Make sure the module is the 433 MHz version (the longer spring antenna;
868 MHz modules are often marked 8xx) and that the antenna is soldered on.

| MOSI | GPIO23 | SPI data from the ESP32: frequency, power, send/listen |
| MISO (SO, GDO1) | GPIO19 | SPI data back to the ESP32: chip ID and status |
| CSN | GPIO25 | SPI chip select: low while the ESP32 talks to the chip |
| GDO0 | GPIO26 | Send data: 3.3 V turns the 433 MHz carrier on, 0 V off |
| GDO2 | GPIO27 | Receive data: 3.3 V while the chip hears a carrier |

The four SPI wires only carry settings; the remote codes travel over GDO0
(sending) and GDO2 (receiving) as plain on/off pulses. On some modules MISO
is labelled GDO1.

Make sure the module is the 433 MHz version (the longer spring antenna;
868 MHz modules are often marked 8xx) and that the antenna is soldered on.

| SCK | GPIO18 | SPI clock: timing for the settings link |
| MOSI | GPIO23 | SPI data from the ESP32: frequency, power, send/listen |
| MISO (SO, GDO1) | GPIO19 | SPI data back to the ESP32: chip ID and status |
| CSN | GPIO25 | SPI chip select: low while the ESP32 talks to the chip |
| GDO0 | GPIO26 | Send data: 3.3 V turns the 433 MHz carrier on, 0 V off |
| GDO2 | GPIO27 | Receive data: 3.3 V while the chip hears a carrier |

The four SPI wires only carry settings; the remote codes travel over GDO0
(sending) and GDO2 (receiving) as plain on/off pulses. On some modules MISO
is labelled GDO1.

Make sure the module is the 433 MHz version (the longer spring antenna;
868 MHz modules are often marked 8xx) and that the antenna is soldered on.

| GND | GND | Ground |
| SCK | GPIO18 | SPI clock: timing for the settings link |
| MOSI | GPIO23 | SPI data from the ESP32: frequency, power, send/listen |
| MISO (SO, GDO1) | GPIO19 | SPI data back to the ESP32: chip ID and status |
| CSN | GPIO25 | SPI chip select: low while the ESP32 talks to the chip |
| GDO0 | GPIO26 | Send data: 3.3 V turns the 433 MHz carrier on, 0 V off |
| GDO2 | GPIO27 | Receive data: 3.3 V while the chip hears a carrier |

The four SPI wires only carry settings; the remote codes travel over GDO0
(sending) and GDO2 (receiving) as plain on/off pulses. On some modules MISO
is labelled GDO1.

Make sure the module is the 433 MHz version (the longer spring antenna;
868 MHz modules are often marked 8xx) and that the antenna is soldered on.

| VCC | 3.3V | Power |
| GND | GND | Ground |
| SCK | GPIO18 | SPI clock: timing for the settings link |
| MOSI | GPIO23 | SPI data from the ESP32: frequency, power, send/listen |
| MISO (SO, GDO1) | GPIO19 | SPI data back to the ESP32: chip ID and status |
| CSN | GPIO25 | SPI chip select: low while the ESP32 talks to the chip |
| GDO0 | GPIO26 | Send data: 3.3 V turns the 433 MHz carrier on, 0 V off |
| GDO2 | GPIO27 | Receive data: 3.3 V while the chip hears a carrier |

The four SPI wires only carry settings; the remote codes travel over GDO0
(sending) and GDO2 (receiving) as plain on/off pulses. On some modules MISO
is labelled GDO1.

Make sure the module is the 433 MHz version (the longer spring antenna;
868 MHz modules are often marked 8xx) and that the antenna is soldered on.

| VCC | 3.3V | Power |
| GND | GND | Ground |
| SCK | GPIO18 | SPI clock: timing for the settings link |
| MOSI | GPIO23 | SPI data from the ESP32: frequency, power, send/listen |
| MISO (SO, GDO1) | GPIO19 | SPI data back to the ESP32: chip ID and status |
| CSN | GPIO25 | SPI chip select: low while the ESP32 talks to the chip |
| GDO0 | GPIO26 | Send data: 3.3 V turns the 433 MHz carrier on, 0 V off |
| GDO2 | GPIO27 | Receive data: 3.3 V while the chip hears a carrier |

The four SPI wires only carry settings; the remote codes travel over GDO0
(sending) and GDO2 (receiving) as plain on/off pulses. On some modules MISO
is labelled GDO1.

Make sure the module is the 433 MHz version (the longer spring antenna;
868 MHz modules are often marked 8xx) and that the antenna is soldered on.

| --- | --- | --- |
| VCC | 3.3V | Power |
| GND | GND | Ground |
| SCK | GPIO18 | SPI clock: timing for the settings link |
| MOSI | GPIO23 | SPI data from the ESP32: frequency, power, send/listen |
| MISO (SO, GDO1) | GPIO19 | SPI data back to the ESP32: chip ID and status |
| CSN | GPIO25 | SPI chip select: low while the ESP32 talks to the chip |
| GDO0 | GPIO26 | Send data: 3.3 V turns the 433 MHz carrier on, 0 V off |
| GDO2 | GPIO27 | Receive data: 3.3 V while the chip hears a carrier |

The four SPI wires only carry settings; the remote codes travel over GDO0
(sending) and GDO2 (receiving) as plain on/off pulses. On some modules MISO
is labelled GDO1.

Make sure the module is the 433 MHz version (the longer spring antenna;
868 MHz modules are often marked 8xx) and that the antenna is soldered on.

t| CC1101 | ESP32 | Function |

| VCC | 3.3V | Power |
| GND | GND | Ground |

(sending) and GDO2 (receiving) as plain on/off pulses. On some modules MISO
is labelled GDO1.

Make sure the module is the 433 MHz version (the longer spring antenna;
868 MHz modules are often marked 8xx) and that the antenna is soldered on.

| GDO2 | GPIO27 | Receive data: 3.3 V while the chip hears a carrier |

The four SPI wires only carry settings; the remote codes travel over GDO0
(sending) and GDO2 (receiving) as plain on/off pulses. On some modules MISO
is labelled GDO1.

Make sure the module is the 433 MHz version (the longer spring antenna;
868 MHz modules are often marked 8xx) and that the antenna is soldered on.

| CSN | GPIO25 | SPI chip select: low while the ESP32 talks to the chip |
| GDO0 | GPIO26 | Send data: 3.3 V turns the 433 MHz carrier on, 0 V off |
| GDO2 | GPIO27 | Receive data: 3.3 V while the chip hears a carrier |

The four SPI wires only carry settings; the remote codes travel over GDO0
(sending) and GDO2 (receiving) as plain on/off pulses. On some modules MISO
is labelled GDO1.

Make sure the module is the 433 MHz version (the longer spring antenna;
868 MHz modules are often marked 8xx) and that the antenna is soldered on.

| MOSI | GPIO23 | SPI data from the ESP32: frequency, power, send/listen |
| MISO (SO, GDO1) | GPIO19 | SPI data back to the ESP32: chip ID and status |
| CSN | GPIO25 | SPI chip select: low while the ESP32 talks to the chip |
| GDO0 | GPIO26 | Send data: 3.3 V turns the 433 MHz carrier on, 0 V off |
| GDO2 | GPIO27 | Receive data: 3.3 V while the chip hears a carrier |

The four SPI wires only carry settings; the remote codes travel over GDO0
(sending) and GDO2 (receiving) as plain on/off pulses. On some modules MISO
is labelled GDO1.

Make sure the module is the 433 MHz version (the longer spring antenna;
868 MHz modules are often marked 8xx) and that the antenna is soldered on.

| SCK | GPIO18 | SPI clock: timing for the settings link |
| MOSI | GPIO23 | SPI data from the ESP32: frequency, power, send/listen |
| MISO (SO, GDO1) | GPIO19 | SPI data back to the ESP32: chip ID and status |
| CSN | GPIO25 | SPI chip select: low while the ESP32 talks to the chip |
| GDO0 | GPIO26 | Send data: 3.3 V turns the 433 MHz carrier on, 0 V off |
| GDO2 | GPIO27 | Receive data: 3.3 V while the chip hears a carrier |

The four SPI wires only carry settings; the remote codes travel over GDO0
(sending) and GDO2 (receiving) as plain on/off pulses. On some modules MISO
is labelled GDO1.

Make sure the module is the 433 MHz version (the longer spring antenna;
868 MHz modules are often marked 8xx) and that the antenna is soldered on.

| GND | GND | Ground |
| SCK | GPIO18 | SPI clock: timing for the settings link |
| MOSI | GPIO23 | SPI data from the ESP32: frequency, power, send/listen |
| MISO (SO, GDO1) | GPIO19 | SPI data back to the ESP32: chip ID and status |
| CSN | GPIO25 | SPI chip select: low while the ESP32 talks to the chip |
| GDO0 | GPIO26 | Send data: 3.3 V turns the 433 MHz carrier on, 0 V off |
| GDO2 | GPIO27 | Receive data: 3.3 V while the chip hears a carrier |

The four SPI wires only carry settings; the remote codes travel over GDO0
(sending) and GDO2 (receiving) as plain on/off pulses. On some modules MISO
is labelled GDO1.

Make sure the module is the 433 MHz version (the longer spring antenna;
868 MHz modules are often marked 8xx) and that the antenna is soldered on.

| VCC | 3.3V | Power |
| GND | GND | Ground |
| SCK | GPIO18 | SPI clock: timing for the settings link |
| MOSI | GPIO23 | SPI data from the ESP32: frequency, power, send/listen |
| MISO (SO, GDO1) | GPIO19 | SPI data back to the ESP32: chip ID and status |
| CSN | GPIO25 | SPI chip select: low while the ESP32 talks to the chip |
| GDO0 | GPIO26 | Send data: 3.3 V turns the 433 MHz carrier on, 0 V off |
| GDO2 | GPIO27 | Receive data: 3.3 V while the chip hears a carrier |

The four SPI wires only carry settings; the remote codes travel over GDO0
(sending) and GDO2 (receiving) as plain on/off pulses. On some modules MISO
is labelled GDO1.

Make sure the module is the 433 MHz version (the longer spring antenna;
868 MHz modules are often marked 8xx) and that the antenna is soldered on.

| --- | --- | --- |
| VCC | 3.3V | Power |
| GND | GND | Ground |
| SCK | GPIO18 | SPI clock: timing for the settings link |
| MOSI | GPIO23 | SPI data from the ESP32: frequency, power, send/listen |
| MISO (SO, GDO1) | GPIO19 | SPI data back to the ESP32: chip ID and status |
| CSN | GPIO25 | SPI chip select: low while the ESP32 talks to the chip |
| GDO0 | GPIO26 | Send data: 3.3 V turns the 433 MHz carrier on, 0 V off |
| GDO2 | GPIO27 | Receive data: 3.3 V while the chip hears a carrier |

The four SPI wires only carry settings; the remote codes travel over GDO0
(sending) and GDO2 (receiving) as plain on/off pulses. On some modules MISO
is labelled GDO1.

Make sure the module is the 433 MHz version (the longer spring antenna;
868 MHz modules are often marked 8xx) and that the antenna is soldered on.

(sending) and GDO2 (receiving) as plain on/off pulses. On some modules MISO
is labelled GDO1.

Make sure the module is the 433 MHz version (the longer spring antenna;
868 MHz modules are often marked 8xx) and that the antenna is soldered on.

| GDO2 | GPIO27 | Receive data: 3.3 V while the chip hears a carrier |

The four SPI wires only carry settings; the remote codes travel over GDO0
(sending) and GDO2 (receiving) as plain on/off pulses. On some modules MISO
is labelled GDO1.

Make sure the module is the 433 MHz version (the longer spring antenna;
868 MHz modules are often marked 8xx) and that the antenna is soldered on.

| CSN | GPIO25 | SPI chip select: low while the ESP32 talks to the chip |
| GDO0 | GPIO26 | Send data: 3.3 V turns the 433 MHz carrier on, 0 V off |
| GDO2 | GPIO27 | Receive data: 3.3 V while the chip hears a carrier |

The four SPI wires only carry settings; the remote codes travel over GDO0
(sending) and GDO2 (receiving) as plain on/off pulses. On some modules MISO
is labelled GDO1.

Make sure the module is the 433 MHz version (the longer spring antenna;
868 MHz modules are often marked 8xx) and that the antenna is soldered on.

| MOSI | GPIO23 | SPI data from the ESP32: frequency, power, send/listen |
| MISO (SO, GDO1) | GPIO19 | SPI data back to the ESP32: chip ID and status |
| CSN | GPIO25 | SPI chip select: low while the ESP32 talks to the chip |
| GDO0 | GPIO26 | Send data: 3.3 V turns the 433 MHz carrier on, 0 V off |
| GDO2 | GPIO27 | Receive data: 3.3 V while the chip hears a carrier |

The four SPI wires only carry settings; the remote codes travel over GDO0
(sending) and GDO2 (receiving) as plain on/off pulses. On some modules MISO
is labelled GDO1.

Make sure the module is the 433 MHz version (the longer spring antenna;
868 MHz modules are often marked 8xx) and that the antenna is soldered on.

| SCK | GPIO18 | SPI clock: timing for the settings link |
| MOSI | GPIO23 | SPI data from the ESP32: frequency, power, send/listen |
| MISO (SO, GDO1) | GPIO19 | SPI data back to the ESP32: chip ID and status |
| CSN | GPIO25 | SPI chip select: low while the ESP32 talks to the chip |
| GDO0 | GPIO26 | Send data: 3.3 V turns the 433 MHz carrier on, 0 V off |
| GDO2 | GPIO27 | Receive data: 3.3 V while the chip hears a carrier |

The four SPI wires only carry settings; the remote codes travel over GDO0
(sending) and GDO2 (receiving) as plain on/off pulses. On some modules MISO
is labelled GDO1.

Make sure the module is the 433 MHz version (the longer spring antenna;
868 MHz modules are often marked 8xx) and that the antenna is soldered on.

| GND | GND | Ground |
| SCK | GPIO18 | SPI clock: timing for the settings link |
| MOSI | GPIO23 | SPI data from the ESP32: frequency, power, send/listen |
| MISO (SO, GDO1) | GPIO19 | SPI data back to the ESP32: chip ID and status |
| CSN | GPIO25 | SPI chip select: low while the ESP32 talks to the chip |
| GDO0 | GPIO26 | Send data: 3.3 V turns the 433 MHz carrier on, 0 V off |
| GDO2 | GPIO27 | Receive data: 3.3 V while the chip hears a carrier |

The four SPI wires only carry settings; the remote codes travel over GDO0
(sending) and GDO2 (receiving) as plain on/off pulses. On some modules MISO
is labelled GDO1.

Make sure the module is the 433 MHz version (the longer spring antenna;
868 MHz modules are often marked 8xx) and that the antenna is soldered on.

| VCC | 3.3V | Power |
| GND | GND | Ground |
| SCK | GPIO18 | SPI clock: timing for the settings link |
| MOSI | GPIO23 | SPI data from the ESP32: frequency, power, send/listen |
| MISO (SO, GDO1) | GPIO19 | SPI data back to the ESP32: chip ID and status |
| CSN | GPIO25 | SPI chip select: low while the ESP32 talks to the chip |
| GDO0 | GPIO26 | Send data: 3.3 V turns the 433 MHz carrier on, 0 V off |
| GDO2 | GPIO27 | Receive data: 3.3 V while the chip hears a carrier |

The four SPI wires only carry settings; the remote codes travel over GDO0
(sending) and GDO2 (receiving) as plain on/off pulses. On some modules MISO
is labelled GDO1.

Make sure the module is the 433 MHz version (the longer spring antenna;
868 MHz modules are often marked 8xx) and that the antenna is soldered on.

| --- | --- | --- |
| VCC | 3.3V | Power |
| GND | GND | Ground |
| SCK | GPIO18 | SPI clock: timing for the settings link |
| MOSI | GPIO23 | SPI data from the ESP32: frequency, power, send/listen |
| MISO (SO, GDO1) | GPIO19 | SPI data back to the ESP32: chip ID and status |
| CSN | GPIO25 | SPI chip select: low while the ESP32 talks to the chip |
| GDO0 | GPIO26 | Send data: 3.3 V turns the 433 MHz carrier on, 0 V off |
| GDO2 | GPIO27 | Receive data: 3.3 V while the chip hears a carrier |

The four SPI wires only carry settings; the remote codes travel over GDO0
(sending) and GDO2 (receiving) as plain on/off pulses. On some modules MISO
is labelled GDO1.

Make sure the module is the 433 MHz version (the longer spring antenna;
868 MHz modules are often marked 8xx) and that the antenna is soldered on.

| GND | GND | Ground |

(sending) and GDO2 (receiving) as plain on/off pulses. On some modules MISO
is labelled GDO1.

Make sure the module is the 433 MHz version (the longer spring antenna;
868 MHz modules are often marked 8xx) and that the antenna is soldered on.

| GDO2 | GPIO27 | Receive data: 3.3 V while the chip hears a carrier |

The four SPI wires only carry settings; the remote codes travel over GDO0
(sending) and GDO2 (receiving) as plain on/off pulses. On some modules MISO
is labelled GDO1.

Make sure the module is the 433 MHz version (the longer spring antenna;
868 MHz modules are often marked 8xx) and that the antenna is soldered on.

| CSN | GPIO25 | SPI chip select: low while the ESP32 talks to the chip |
| GDO0 | GPIO26 | Send data: 3.3 V turns the 433 MHz carrier on, 0 V off |
| GDO2 | GPIO27 | Receive data: 3.3 V while the chip hears a carrier |

The four SPI wires only carry settings; the remote codes travel over GDO0
(sending) and GDO2 (receiving) as plain on/off pulses. On some modules MISO
is labelled GDO1.

Make sure the module is the 433 MHz version (the longer spring antenna;
868 MHz modules are often marked 8xx) and that the antenna is soldered on.

| MOSI | GPIO23 | SPI data from the ESP32: frequency, power, send/listen |
| MISO (SO, GDO1) | GPIO19 | SPI data back to the ESP32: chip ID and status |
| CSN | GPIO25 | SPI chip select: low while the ESP32 talks to the chip |
| GDO0 | GPIO26 | Send data: 3.3 V turns the 433 MHz carrier on, 0 V off |
| GDO2 | GPIO27 | Receive data: 3.3 V while the chip hears a carrier |

The four SPI wires only carry settings; the remote codes travel over GDO0
(sending) and GDO2 (receiving) as plain on/off pulses. On some modules MISO
is labelled GDO1.

Make sure the module is the 433 MHz version (the longer spring antenna;
868 MHz modules are often marked 8xx) and that the antenna is soldered on.

| SCK | GPIO18 | SPI clock: timing for the settings link |
| MOSI | GPIO23 | SPI data from the ESP32: frequency, power, send/listen |
| MISO (SO, GDO1) | GPIO19 | SPI data back to the ESP32: chip ID and status |
| CSN | GPIO25 | SPI chip select: low while the ESP32 talks to the chip |
| GDO0 | GPIO26 | Send data: 3.3 V turns the 433 MHz carrier on, 0 V off |
| GDO2 | GPIO27 | Receive data: 3.3 V while the chip hears a carrier |

The four SPI wires only carry settings; the remote codes travel over GDO0
(sending) and GDO2 (receiving) as plain on/off pulses. On some modules MISO
is labelled GDO1.

Make sure the module is the 433 MHz version (the longer spring antenna;
868 MHz modules are often marked 8xx) and that the antenna is soldered on.

| GND | GND | Ground |
| SCK | GPIO18 | SPI clock: timing for the settings link |
| MOSI | GPIO23 | SPI data from the ESP32: frequency, power, send/listen |
| MISO (SO, GDO1) | GPIO19 | SPI data back to the ESP32: chip ID and status |
| CSN | GPIO25 | SPI chip select: low while the ESP32 talks to the chip |
| GDO0 | GPIO26 | Send data: 3.3 V turns the 433 MHz carrier on, 0 V off |
| GDO2 | GPIO27 | Receive data: 3.3 V while the chip hears a carrier |

The four SPI wires only carry settings; the remote codes travel over GDO0
(sending) and GDO2 (receiving) as plain on/off pulses. On some modules MISO
is labelled GDO1.

Make sure the module is the 433 MHz version (the longer spring antenna;
868 MHz modules are often marked 8xx) and that the antenna is soldered on.

| VCC | 3.3V | Power |
| GND | GND | Ground |
| SCK | GPIO18 | SPI clock: timing for the settings link |
| MOSI | GPIO23 | SPI data from the ESP32: frequency, power, send/listen |
| MISO (SO, GDO1) | GPIO19 | SPI data back to the ESP32: chip ID and status |
| CSN | GPIO25 | SPI chip select: low while the ESP32 talks to the chip |
| GDO0 | GPIO26 | Send data: 3.3 V turns the 433 MHz carrier on, 0 V off |
| GDO2 | GPIO27 | Receive data: 3.3 V while the chip hears a carrier |

The four SPI wires only carry settings; the remote codes travel over GDO0
(sending) and GDO2 (receiving) as plain on/off pulses. On some modules MISO
is labelled GDO1.

Make sure the module is the 433 MHz version (the longer spring antenna;
868 MHz modules are often marked 8xx) and that the antenna is soldered on.

| --- | --- | --- |
| VCC | 3.3V | Power |
| GND | GND | Ground |
| SCK | GPIO18 | SPI clock: timing for the settings link |
| MOSI | GPIO23 | SPI data from the ESP32: frequency, power, send/listen |
| MISO (SO, GDO1) | GPIO19 | SPI data back to the ESP32: chip ID and status |
| CSN | GPIO25 | SPI chip select: low while the ESP32 talks to the chip |
| GDO0 | GPIO26 | Send data: 3.3 V turns the 433 MHz carrier on, 0 V off |
| GDO2 | GPIO27 | Receive data: 3.3 V while the chip hears a carrier |

The four SPI wires only carry settings; the remote codes travel over GDO0
(sending) and GDO2 (receiving) as plain on/off pulses. On some modules MISO
is labelled GDO1.

Make sure the module is the 433 MHz version (the longer spring antenna;
868 MHz modules are often marked 8xx) and that the antenna is soldered on.

n| CC1101 | ESP32 | Function |
| --- | --- | --- |
| VCC | 3.3V | Power |
| GND | GND | Ground |

(sending) and GDO2 (receiving) as plain on/off pulses. On some modules MISO
is labelled GDO1.

Make sure the module is the 433 MHz version (the longer spring antenna;
868 MHz modules are often marked 8xx) and that the antenna is soldered on.

| GDO2 | GPIO27 | Receive data: 3.3 V while the chip hears a carrier |

The four SPI wires only carry settings; the remote codes travel over GDO0
(sending) and GDO2 (receiving) as plain on/off pulses. On some modules MISO
is labelled GDO1.

Make sure the module is the 433 MHz version (the longer spring antenna;
868 MHz modules are often marked 8xx) and that the antenna is soldered on.

| CSN | GPIO25 | SPI chip select: low while the ESP32 talks to the chip |
| GDO0 | GPIO26 | Send data: 3.3 V turns the 433 MHz carrier on, 0 V off |
| GDO2 | GPIO27 | Receive data: 3.3 V while the chip hears a carrier |

The four SPI wires only carry settings; the remote codes travel over GDO0
(sending) and GDO2 (receiving) as plain on/off pulses. On some modules MISO
is labelled GDO1.

Make sure the module is the 433 MHz version (the longer spring antenna;
868 MHz modules are often marked 8xx) and that the antenna is soldered on.

| MOSI | GPIO23 | SPI data from the ESP32: frequency, power, send/listen |
| MISO (SO, GDO1) | GPIO19 | SPI data back to the ESP32: chip ID and status |
| CSN | GPIO25 | SPI chip select: low while the ESP32 talks to the chip |
| GDO0 | GPIO26 | Send data: 3.3 V turns the 433 MHz carrier on, 0 V off |
| GDO2 | GPIO27 | Receive data: 3.3 V while the chip hears a carrier |

The four SPI wires only carry settings; the remote codes travel over GDO0
(sending) and GDO2 (receiving) as plain on/off pulses. On some modules MISO
is labelled GDO1.

Make sure the module is the 433 MHz version (the longer spring antenna;
868 MHz modules are often marked 8xx) and that the antenna is soldered on.

| SCK | GPIO18 | SPI clock: timing for the settings link |
| MOSI | GPIO23 | SPI data from the ESP32: frequency, power, send/listen |
| MISO (SO, GDO1) | GPIO19 | SPI data back to the ESP32: chip ID and status |
| CSN | GPIO25 | SPI chip select: low while the ESP32 talks to the chip |
| GDO0 | GPIO26 | Send data: 3.3 V turns the 433 MHz carrier on, 0 V off |
| GDO2 | GPIO27 | Receive data: 3.3 V while the chip hears a carrier |

The four SPI wires only carry settings; the remote codes travel over GDO0
(sending) and GDO2 (receiving) as plain on/off pulses. On some modules MISO
is labelled GDO1.

Make sure the module is the 433 MHz version (the longer spring antenna;
868 MHz modules are often marked 8xx) and that the antenna is soldered on.

| GND | GND | Ground |
| SCK | GPIO18 | SPI clock: timing for the settings link |
| MOSI | GPIO23 | SPI data from the ESP32: frequency, power, send/listen |
| MISO (SO, GDO1) | GPIO19 | SPI data back to the ESP32: chip ID and status |
| CSN | GPIO25 | SPI chip select: low while the ESP32 talks to the chip |
| GDO0 | GPIO26 | Send data: 3.3 V turns the 433 MHz carrier on, 0 V off |
| GDO2 | GPIO27 | Receive data: 3.3 V while the chip hears a carrier |

The four SPI wires only carry settings; the remote codes travel over GDO0
(sending) and GDO2 (receiving) as plain on/off pulses. On some modules MISO
is labelled GDO1.

Make sure the module is the 433 MHz version (the longer spring antenna;
868 MHz modules are often marked 8xx) and that the antenna is soldered on.

| VCC | 3.3V | Power |
| GND | GND | Ground |
| SCK | GPIO18 | SPI clock: timing for the settings link |
| MOSI | GPIO23 | SPI data from the ESP32: frequency, power, send/listen |
| MISO (SO, GDO1) | GPIO19 | SPI data back to the ESP32: chip ID and status |
| CSN | GPIO25 | SPI chip select: low while the ESP32 talks to the chip |
| GDO0 | GPIO26 | Send data: 3.3 V turns the 433 MHz carrier on, 0 V off |
| GDO2 | GPIO27 | Receive data: 3.3 V while the chip hears a carrier |

The four SPI wires only carry settings; the remote codes travel over GDO0
(sending) and GDO2 (receiving) as plain on/off pulses. On some modules MISO
is labelled GDO1.

Make sure the module is the 433 MHz version (the longer spring antenna;
868 MHz modules are often marked 8xx) and that the antenna is soldered on.

| --- | --- | --- |
| VCC | 3.3V | Power |
| GND | GND | Ground |
| SCK | GPIO18 | SPI clock: timing for the settings link |
| MOSI | GPIO23 | SPI data from the ESP32: frequency, power, send/listen |
| MISO (SO, GDO1) | GPIO19 | SPI data back to the ESP32: chip ID and status |
| CSN | GPIO25 | SPI chip select: low while the ESP32 talks to the chip |
| GDO0 | GPIO26 | Send data: 3.3 V turns the 433 MHz carrier on, 0 V off |
| GDO2 | GPIO27 | Receive data: 3.3 V while the chip hears a carrier |

The four SPI wires only carry settings; the remote codes travel over GDO0
(sending) and GDO2 (receiving) as plain on/off pulses. On some modules MISO
is labelled GDO1.

Make sure the module is the 433 MHz version (the longer spring antenna;
868 MHz modules are often marked 8xx) and that the antenna is soldered on.

e| CC1101 | ESP32 | Function |
| --- | --- | --- |
| VCC | 3.3V | Power |
| GND | GND | Ground |

(sending) and GDO2 (receiving) as plain on/off pulses. On some modules MISO
is labelled GDO1.

Make sure the module is the 433 MHz version (the longer spring antenna;
868 MHz modules are often marked 8xx) and that the antenna is soldered on.

| GDO2 | GPIO27 | Receive data: 3.3 V while the chip hears a carrier |

The four SPI wires only carry settings; the remote codes travel over GDO0
(sending) and GDO2 (receiving) as plain on/off pulses. On some modules MISO
is labelled GDO1.

Make sure the module is the 433 MHz version (the longer spring antenna;
868 MHz modules are often marked 8xx) and that the antenna is soldered on.

| CSN | GPIO25 | SPI chip select: low while the ESP32 talks to the chip |
| GDO0 | GPIO26 | Send data: 3.3 V turns the 433 MHz carrier on, 0 V off |
| GDO2 | GPIO27 | Receive data: 3.3 V while the chip hears a carrier |

The four SPI wires only carry settings; the remote codes travel over GDO0
(sending) and GDO2 (receiving) as plain on/off pulses. On some modules MISO
is labelled GDO1.

Make sure the module is the 433 MHz version (the longer spring antenna;
868 MHz modules are often marked 8xx) and that the antenna is soldered on.

| MOSI | GPIO23 | SPI data from the ESP32: frequency, power, send/listen |
| MISO (SO, GDO1) | GPIO19 | SPI data back to the ESP32: chip ID and status |
| CSN | GPIO25 | SPI chip select: low while the ESP32 talks to the chip |
| GDO0 | GPIO26 | Send data: 3.3 V turns the 433 MHz carrier on, 0 V off |
| GDO2 | GPIO27 | Receive data: 3.3 V while the chip hears a carrier |

The four SPI wires only carry settings; the remote codes travel over GDO0
(sending) and GDO2 (receiving) as plain on/off pulses. On some modules MISO
is labelled GDO1.

Make sure the module is the 433 MHz version (the longer spring antenna;
868 MHz modules are often marked 8xx) and that the antenna is soldered on.

| SCK | GPIO18 | SPI clock: timing for the settings link |
| MOSI | GPIO23 | SPI data from the ESP32: frequency, power, send/listen |
| MISO (SO, GDO1) | GPIO19 | SPI data back to the ESP32: chip ID and status |
| CSN | GPIO25 | SPI chip select: low while the ESP32 talks to the chip |
| GDO0 | GPIO26 | Send data: 3.3 V turns the 433 MHz carrier on, 0 V off |
| GDO2 | GPIO27 | Receive data: 3.3 V while the chip hears a carrier |

The four SPI wires only carry settings; the remote codes travel over GDO0
(sending) and GDO2 (receiving) as plain on/off pulses. On some modules MISO
is labelled GDO1.

Make sure the module is the 433 MHz version (the longer spring antenna;
868 MHz modules are often marked 8xx) and that the antenna is soldered on.

| GND | GND | Ground |
| SCK | GPIO18 | SPI clock: timing for the settings link |
| MOSI | GPIO23 | SPI data from the ESP32: frequency, power, send/listen |
| MISO (SO, GDO1) | GPIO19 | SPI data back to the ESP32: chip ID and status |
| CSN | GPIO25 | SPI chip select: low while the ESP32 talks to the chip |
| GDO0 | GPIO26 | Send data: 3.3 V turns the 433 MHz carrier on, 0 V off |
| GDO2 | GPIO27 | Receive data: 3.3 V while the chip hears a carrier |

The four SPI wires only carry settings; the remote codes travel over GDO0
(sending) and GDO2 (receiving) as plain on/off pulses. On some modules MISO
is labelled GDO1.

Make sure the module is the 433 MHz version (the longer spring antenna;
868 MHz modules are often marked 8xx) and that the antenna is soldered on.

| VCC | 3.3V | Power |
| GND | GND | Ground |
| SCK | GPIO18 | SPI clock: timing for the settings link |
| MOSI | GPIO23 | SPI data from the ESP32: frequency, power, send/listen |
| MISO (SO, GDO1) | GPIO19 | SPI data back to the ESP32: chip ID and status |
| CSN | GPIO25 | SPI chip select: low while the ESP32 talks to the chip |
| GDO0 | GPIO26 | Send data: 3.3 V turns the 433 MHz carrier on, 0 V off |
| GDO2 | GPIO27 | Receive data: 3.3 V while the chip hears a carrier |

The four SPI wires only carry settings; the remote codes travel over GDO0
(sending) and GDO2 (receiving) as plain on/off pulses. On some modules MISO
is labelled GDO1.

Make sure the module is the 433 MHz version (the longer spring antenna;
868 MHz modules are often marked 8xx) and that the antenna is soldered on.

| --- | --- | --- |
| VCC | 3.3V | Power |
| GND | GND | Ground |
| SCK | GPIO18 | SPI clock: timing for the settings link |
| MOSI | GPIO23 | SPI data from the ESP32: frequency, power, send/listen |
| MISO (SO, GDO1) | GPIO19 | SPI data back to the ESP32: chip ID and status |
| CSN | GPIO25 | SPI chip select: low while the ESP32 talks to the chip |
| GDO0 | GPIO26 | Send data: 3.3 V turns the 433 MHz carrier on, 0 V off |
| GDO2 | GPIO27 | Receive data: 3.3 V while the chip hears a carrier |

The four SPI wires only carry settings; the remote codes travel over GDO0
(sending) and GDO2 (receiving) as plain on/off pulses. On some modules MISO
is labelled GDO1.

Make sure the module is the 433 MHz version (the longer spring antenna;
868 MHz modules are often marked 8xx) and that the antenna is soldered on.

| GND | GND | Ground |

(sending) and GDO2 (receiving) as plain on/off pulses. On some modules MISO
is labelled GDO1.

Make sure the module is the 433 MHz version (the longer spring antenna;
868 MHz modules are often marked 8xx) and that the antenna is soldered on.

| GDO2 | GPIO27 | Receive data: 3.3 V while the chip hears a carrier |

The four SPI wires only carry settings; the remote codes travel over GDO0
(sending) and GDO2 (receiving) as plain on/off pulses. On some modules MISO
is labelled GDO1.

Make sure the module is the 433 MHz version (the longer spring antenna;
868 MHz modules are often marked 8xx) and that the antenna is soldered on.

| CSN | GPIO25 | SPI chip select: low while the ESP32 talks to the chip |
| GDO0 | GPIO26 | Send data: 3.3 V turns the 433 MHz carrier on, 0 V off |
| GDO2 | GPIO27 | Receive data: 3.3 V while the chip hears a carrier |

The four SPI wires only carry settings; the remote codes travel over GDO0
(sending) and GDO2 (receiving) as plain on/off pulses. On some modules MISO
is labelled GDO1.

Make sure the module is the 433 MHz version (the longer spring antenna;
868 MHz modules are often marked 8xx) and that the antenna is soldered on.

| MOSI | GPIO23 | SPI data from the ESP32: frequency, power, send/listen |
| MISO (SO, GDO1) | GPIO19 | SPI data back to the ESP32: chip ID and status |
| CSN | GPIO25 | SPI chip select: low while the ESP32 talks to the chip |
| GDO0 | GPIO26 | Send data: 3.3 V turns the 433 MHz carrier on, 0 V off |
| GDO2 | GPIO27 | Receive data: 3.3 V while the chip hears a carrier |

The four SPI wires only carry settings; the remote codes travel over GDO0
(sending) and GDO2 (receiving) as plain on/off pulses. On some modules MISO
is labelled GDO1.

Make sure the module is the 433 MHz version (the longer spring antenna;
868 MHz modules are often marked 8xx) and that the antenna is soldered on.

| SCK | GPIO18 | SPI clock: timing for the settings link |
| MOSI | GPIO23 | SPI data from the ESP32: frequency, power, send/listen |
| MISO (SO, GDO1) | GPIO19 | SPI data back to the ESP32: chip ID and status |
| CSN | GPIO25 | SPI chip select: low while the ESP32 talks to the chip |
| GDO0 | GPIO26 | Send data: 3.3 V turns the 433 MHz carrier on, 0 V off |
| GDO2 | GPIO27 | Receive data: 3.3 V while the chip hears a carrier |

The four SPI wires only carry settings; the remote codes travel over GDO0
(sending) and GDO2 (receiving) as plain on/off pulses. On some modules MISO
is labelled GDO1.

Make sure the module is the 433 MHz version (the longer spring antenna;
868 MHz modules are often marked 8xx) and that the antenna is soldered on.

| GND | GND | Ground |
| SCK | GPIO18 | SPI clock: timing for the settings link |
| MOSI | GPIO23 | SPI data from the ESP32: frequency, power, send/listen |
| MISO (SO, GDO1) | GPIO19 | SPI data back to the ESP32: chip ID and status |
| CSN | GPIO25 | SPI chip select: low while the ESP32 talks to the chip |
| GDO0 | GPIO26 | Send data: 3.3 V turns the 433 MHz carrier on, 0 V off |
| GDO2 | GPIO27 | Receive data: 3.3 V while the chip hears a carrier |

The four SPI wires only carry settings; the remote codes travel over GDO0
(sending) and GDO2 (receiving) as plain on/off pulses. On some modules MISO
is labelled GDO1.

Make sure the module is the 433 MHz version (the longer spring antenna;
868 MHz modules are often marked 8xx) and that the antenna is soldered on.

| VCC | 3.3V | Power |
| GND | GND | Ground |
| SCK | GPIO18 | SPI clock: timing for the settings link |
| MOSI | GPIO23 | SPI data from the ESP32: frequency, power, send/listen |
| MISO (SO, GDO1) | GPIO19 | SPI data back to the ESP32: chip ID and status |
| CSN | GPIO25 | SPI chip select: low while the ESP32 talks to the chip |
| GDO0 | GPIO26 | Send data: 3.3 V turns the 433 MHz carrier on, 0 V off |
| GDO2 | GPIO27 | Receive data: 3.3 V while the chip hears a carrier |

The four SPI wires only carry settings; the remote codes travel over GDO0
(sending) and GDO2 (receiving) as plain on/off pulses. On some modules MISO
is labelled GDO1.

Make sure the module is the 433 MHz version (the longer spring antenna;
868 MHz modules are often marked 8xx) and that the antenna is soldered on.

| --- | --- | --- |
| VCC | 3.3V | Power |
| GND | GND | Ground |
| SCK | GPIO18 | SPI clock: timing for the settings link |
| MOSI | GPIO23 | SPI data from the ESP32: frequency, power, send/listen |
| MISO (SO, GDO1) | GPIO19 | SPI data back to the ESP32: chip ID and status |
| CSN | GPIO25 | SPI chip select: low while the ESP32 talks to the chip |
| GDO0 | GPIO26 | Send data: 3.3 V turns the 433 MHz carrier on, 0 V off |
| GDO2 | GPIO27 | Receive data: 3.3 V while the chip hears a carrier |

The four SPI wires only carry settings; the remote codes travel over GDO0
(sending) and GDO2 (receiving) as plain on/off pulses. On some modules MISO
is labelled GDO1.

Make sure the module is the 433 MHz version (the longer spring antenna;
868 MHz modules are often marked 8xx) and that the antenna is soldered on.

| GND | GND | Ground |

(sending) and GDO2 (receiving) as plain on/off pulses. On some modules MISO
is labelled GDO1.

Make sure the module is the 433 MHz version (the longer spring antenna;
868 MHz modules are often marked 8xx) and that the antenna is soldered on.

| GDO2 | GPIO27 | Receive data: 3.3 V while the chip hears a carrier |

The four SPI wires only carry settings; the remote codes travel over GDO0
(sending) and GDO2 (receiving) as plain on/off pulses. On some modules MISO
is labelled GDO1.

Make sure the module is the 433 MHz version (the longer spring antenna;
868 MHz modules are often marked 8xx) and that the antenna is soldered on.

| CSN | GPIO25 | SPI chip select: low while the ESP32 talks to the chip |
| GDO0 | GPIO26 | Send data: 3.3 V turns the 433 MHz carrier on, 0 V off |
| GDO2 | GPIO27 | Receive data: 3.3 V while the chip hears a carrier |

The four SPI wires only carry settings; the remote codes travel over GDO0
(sending) and GDO2 (receiving) as plain on/off pulses. On some modules MISO
is labelled GDO1.

Make sure the module is the 433 MHz version (the longer spring antenna;
868 MHz modules are often marked 8xx) and that the antenna is soldered on.

| MOSI | GPIO23 | SPI data from the ESP32: frequency, power, send/listen |
| MISO (SO, GDO1) | GPIO19 | SPI data back to the ESP32: chip ID and status |
| CSN | GPIO25 | SPI chip select: low while the ESP32 talks to the chip |
| GDO0 | GPIO26 | Send data: 3.3 V turns the 433 MHz carrier on, 0 V off |
| GDO2 | GPIO27 | Receive data: 3.3 V while the chip hears a carrier |

The four SPI wires only carry settings; the remote codes travel over GDO0
(sending) and GDO2 (receiving) as plain on/off pulses. On some modules MISO
is labelled GDO1.

Make sure the module is the 433 MHz version (the longer spring antenna;
868 MHz modules are often marked 8xx) and that the antenna is soldered on.

| SCK | GPIO18 | SPI clock: timing for the settings link |
| MOSI | GPIO23 | SPI data from the ESP32: frequency, power, send/listen |
| MISO (SO, GDO1) | GPIO19 | SPI data back to the ESP32: chip ID and status |
| CSN | GPIO25 | SPI chip select: low while the ESP32 talks to the chip |
| GDO0 | GPIO26 | Send data: 3.3 V turns the 433 MHz carrier on, 0 V off |
| GDO2 | GPIO27 | Receive data: 3.3 V while the chip hears a carrier |

The four SPI wires only carry settings; the remote codes travel over GDO0
(sending) and GDO2 (receiving) as plain on/off pulses. On some modules MISO
is labelled GDO1.

Make sure the module is the 433 MHz version (the longer spring antenna;
868 MHz modules are often marked 8xx) and that the antenna is soldered on.

| GND | GND | Ground |
| SCK | GPIO18 | SPI clock: timing for the settings link |
| MOSI | GPIO23 | SPI data from the ESP32: frequency, power, send/listen |
| MISO (SO, GDO1) | GPIO19 | SPI data back to the ESP32: chip ID and status |
| CSN | GPIO25 | SPI chip select: low while the ESP32 talks to the chip |
| GDO0 | GPIO26 | Send data: 3.3 V turns the 433 MHz carrier on, 0 V off |
| GDO2 | GPIO27 | Receive data: 3.3 V while the chip hears a carrier |

The four SPI wires only carry settings; the remote codes travel over GDO0
(sending) and GDO2 (receiving) as plain on/off pulses. On some modules MISO
is labelled GDO1.

Make sure the module is the 433 MHz version (the longer spring antenna;
868 MHz modules are often marked 8xx) and that the antenna is soldered on.

| VCC | 3.3V | Power |
| GND | GND | Ground |
| SCK | GPIO18 | SPI clock: timing for the settings link |
| MOSI | GPIO23 | SPI data from the ESP32: frequency, power, send/listen |
| MISO (SO, GDO1) | GPIO19 | SPI data back to the ESP32: chip ID and status |
| CSN | GPIO25 | SPI chip select: low while the ESP32 talks to the chip |
| GDO0 | GPIO26 | Send data: 3.3 V turns the 433 MHz carrier on, 0 V off |
| GDO2 | GPIO27 | Receive data: 3.3 V while the chip hears a carrier |

The four SPI wires only carry settings; the remote codes travel over GDO0
(sending) and GDO2 (receiving) as plain on/off pulses. On some modules MISO
is labelled GDO1.

Make sure the module is the 433 MHz version (the longer spring antenna;
868 MHz modules are often marked 8xx) and that the antenna is soldered on.

| --- | --- | --- |
| VCC | 3.3V | Power |
| GND | GND | Ground |
| SCK | GPIO18 | SPI clock: timing for the settings link |
| MOSI | GPIO23 | SPI data from the ESP32: frequency, power, send/listen |
| MISO (SO, GDO1) | GPIO19 | SPI data back to the ESP32: chip ID and status |
| CSN | GPIO25 | SPI chip select: low while the ESP32 talks to the chip |
| GDO0 | GPIO26 | Send data: 3.3 V turns the 433 MHz carrier on, 0 V off |
| GDO2 | GPIO27 | Receive data: 3.3 V while the chip hears a carrier |

The four SPI wires only carry settings; the remote codes travel over GDO0
(sending) and GDO2 (receiving) as plain on/off pulses. On some modules MISO
is labelled GDO1.

Make sure the module is the 433 MHz version (the longer spring antenna;
868 MHz modules are often marked 8xx) and that the antenna is soldered on.

L| CC1101 | ESP32 | Function |
| --- | --- | --- |
| VCC | 3.3V | Power |
| GND | GND | Ground |

(sending) and GDO2 (receiving) as plain on/off pulses. On some modules MISO
is labelled GDO1.

Make sure the module is the 433 MHz version (the longer spring antenna;
868 MHz modules are often marked 8xx) and that the antenna is soldered on.

| GDO2 | GPIO27 | Receive data: 3.3 V while the chip hears a carrier |

The four SPI wires only carry settings; the remote codes travel over GDO0
(sending) and GDO2 (receiving) as plain on/off pulses. On some modules MISO
is labelled GDO1.

Make sure the module is the 433 MHz version (the longer spring antenna;
868 MHz modules are often marked 8xx) and that the antenna is soldered on.

| CSN | GPIO25 | SPI chip select: low while the ESP32 talks to the chip |
| GDO0 | GPIO26 | Send data: 3.3 V turns the 433 MHz carrier on, 0 V off |
| GDO2 | GPIO27 | Receive data: 3.3 V while the chip hears a carrier |

The four SPI wires only carry settings; the remote codes travel over GDO0
(sending) and GDO2 (receiving) as plain on/off pulses. On some modules MISO
is labelled GDO1.

Make sure the module is the 433 MHz version (the longer spring antenna;
868 MHz modules are often marked 8xx) and that the antenna is soldered on.

| MOSI | GPIO23 | SPI data from the ESP32: frequency, power, send/listen |
| MISO (SO, GDO1) | GPIO19 | SPI data back to the ESP32: chip ID and status |
| CSN | GPIO25 | SPI chip select: low while the ESP32 talks to the chip |
| GDO0 | GPIO26 | Send data: 3.3 V turns the 433 MHz carrier on, 0 V off |
| GDO2 | GPIO27 | Receive data: 3.3 V while the chip hears a carrier |

The four SPI wires only carry settings; the remote codes travel over GDO0
(sending) and GDO2 (receiving) as plain on/off pulses. On some modules MISO
is labelled GDO1.

Make sure the module is the 433 MHz version (the longer spring antenna;
868 MHz modules are often marked 8xx) and that the antenna is soldered on.

| SCK | GPIO18 | SPI clock: timing for the settings link |
| MOSI | GPIO23 | SPI data from the ESP32: frequency, power, send/listen |
| MISO (SO, GDO1) | GPIO19 | SPI data back to the ESP32: chip ID and status |
| CSN | GPIO25 | SPI chip select: low while the ESP32 talks to the chip |
| GDO0 | GPIO26 | Send data: 3.3 V turns the 433 MHz carrier on, 0 V off |
| GDO2 | GPIO27 | Receive data: 3.3 V while the chip hears a carrier |

The four SPI wires only carry settings; the remote codes travel over GDO0
(sending) and GDO2 (receiving) as plain on/off pulses. On some modules MISO
is labelled GDO1.

Make sure the module is the 433 MHz version (the longer spring antenna;
868 MHz modules are often marked 8xx) and that the antenna is soldered on.

| GND | GND | Ground |
| SCK | GPIO18 | SPI clock: timing for the settings link |
| MOSI | GPIO23 | SPI data from the ESP32: frequency, power, send/listen |
| MISO (SO, GDO1) | GPIO19 | SPI data back to the ESP32: chip ID and status |
| CSN | GPIO25 | SPI chip select: low while the ESP32 talks to the chip |
| GDO0 | GPIO26 | Send data: 3.3 V turns the 433 MHz carrier on, 0 V off |
| GDO2 | GPIO27 | Receive data: 3.3 V while the chip hears a carrier |

The four SPI wires only carry settings; the remote codes travel over GDO0
(sending) and GDO2 (receiving) as plain on/off pulses. On some modules MISO
is labelled GDO1.

Make sure the module is the 433 MHz version (the longer spring antenna;
868 MHz modules are often marked 8xx) and that the antenna is soldered on.

| VCC | 3.3V | Power |
| GND | GND | Ground |
| SCK | GPIO18 | SPI clock: timing for the settings link |
| MOSI | GPIO23 | SPI data from the ESP32: frequency, power, send/listen |
| MISO (SO, GDO1) | GPIO19 | SPI data back to the ESP32: chip ID and status |
| CSN | GPIO25 | SPI chip select: low while the ESP32 talks to the chip |
| GDO0 | GPIO26 | Send data: 3.3 V turns the 433 MHz carrier on, 0 V off |
| GDO2 | GPIO27 | Receive data: 3.3 V while the chip hears a carrier |

The four SPI wires only carry settings; the remote codes travel over GDO0
(sending) and GDO2 (receiving) as plain on/off pulses. On some modules MISO
is labelled GDO1.

Make sure the module is the 433 MHz version (the longer spring antenna;
868 MHz modules are often marked 8xx) and that the antenna is soldered on.

| --- | --- | --- |
| VCC | 3.3V | Power |
| GND | GND | Ground |
| SCK | GPIO18 | SPI clock: timing for the settings link |
| MOSI | GPIO23 | SPI data from the ESP32: frequency, power, send/listen |
| MISO (SO, GDO1) | GPIO19 | SPI data back to the ESP32: chip ID and status |
| CSN | GPIO25 | SPI chip select: low while the ESP32 talks to the chip |
| GDO0 | GPIO26 | Send data: 3.3 V turns the 433 MHz carrier on, 0 V off |
| GDO2 | GPIO27 | Receive data: 3.3 V while the chip hears a carrier |

The four SPI wires only carry settings; the remote codes travel over GDO0
(sending) and GDO2 (receiving) as plain on/off pulses. On some modules MISO
is labelled GDO1.

Make sure the module is the 433 MHz version (the longer spring antenna;
868 MHz modules are often marked 8xx) and that the antenna is soldered on.

| VCC | 3.3V | Power |
| GND | GND | Ground |

(sending) and GDO2 (receiving) as plain on/off pulses. On some modules MISO
is labelled GDO1.

Make sure the module is the 433 MHz version (the longer spring antenna;
868 MHz modules are often marked 8xx) and that the antenna is soldered on.

| GDO2 | GPIO27 | Receive data: 3.3 V while the chip hears a carrier |

The four SPI wires only carry settings; the remote codes travel over GDO0
(sending) and GDO2 (receiving) as plain on/off pulses. On some modules MISO
is labelled GDO1.

Make sure the module is the 433 MHz version (the longer spring antenna;
868 MHz modules are often marked 8xx) and that the antenna is soldered on.

| CSN | GPIO25 | SPI chip select: low while the ESP32 talks to the chip |
| GDO0 | GPIO26 | Send data: 3.3 V turns the 433 MHz carrier on, 0 V off |
| GDO2 | GPIO27 | Receive data: 3.3 V while the chip hears a carrier |

The four SPI wires only carry settings; the remote codes travel over GDO0
(sending) and GDO2 (receiving) as plain on/off pulses. On some modules MISO
is labelled GDO1.

Make sure the module is the 433 MHz version (the longer spring antenna;
868 MHz modules are often marked 8xx) and that the antenna is soldered on.

| MOSI | GPIO23 | SPI data from the ESP32: frequency, power, send/listen |
| MISO (SO, GDO1) | GPIO19 | SPI data back to the ESP32: chip ID and status |
| CSN | GPIO25 | SPI chip select: low while the ESP32 talks to the chip |
| GDO0 | GPIO26 | Send data: 3.3 V turns the 433 MHz carrier on, 0 V off |
| GDO2 | GPIO27 | Receive data: 3.3 V while the chip hears a carrier |

The four SPI wires only carry settings; the remote codes travel over GDO0
(sending) and GDO2 (receiving) as plain on/off pulses. On some modules MISO
is labelled GDO1.

Make sure the module is the 433 MHz version (the longer spring antenna;
868 MHz modules are often marked 8xx) and that the antenna is soldered on.

| SCK | GPIO18 | SPI clock: timing for the settings link |
| MOSI | GPIO23 | SPI data from the ESP32: frequency, power, send/listen |
| MISO (SO, GDO1) | GPIO19 | SPI data back to the ESP32: chip ID and status |
| CSN | GPIO25 | SPI chip select: low while the ESP32 talks to the chip |
| GDO0 | GPIO26 | Send data: 3.3 V turns the 433 MHz carrier on, 0 V off |
| GDO2 | GPIO27 | Receive data: 3.3 V while the chip hears a carrier |

The four SPI wires only carry settings; the remote codes travel over GDO0
(sending) and GDO2 (receiving) as plain on/off pulses. On some modules MISO
is labelled GDO1.

Make sure the module is the 433 MHz version (the longer spring antenna;
868 MHz modules are often marked 8xx) and that the antenna is soldered on.

| GND | GND | Ground |
| SCK | GPIO18 | SPI clock: timing for the settings link |
| MOSI | GPIO23 | SPI data from the ESP32: frequency, power, send/listen |
| MISO (SO, GDO1) | GPIO19 | SPI data back to the ESP32: chip ID and status |
| CSN | GPIO25 | SPI chip select: low while the ESP32 talks to the chip |
| GDO0 | GPIO26 | Send data: 3.3 V turns the 433 MHz carrier on, 0 V off |
| GDO2 | GPIO27 | Receive data: 3.3 V while the chip hears a carrier |

The four SPI wires only carry settings; the remote codes travel over GDO0
(sending) and GDO2 (receiving) as plain on/off pulses. On some modules MISO
is labelled GDO1.

Make sure the module is the 433 MHz version (the longer spring antenna;
868 MHz modules are often marked 8xx) and that the antenna is soldered on.

| VCC | 3.3V | Power |
| GND | GND | Ground |
| SCK | GPIO18 | SPI clock: timing for the settings link |
| MOSI | GPIO23 | SPI data from the ESP32: frequency, power, send/listen |
| MISO (SO, GDO1) | GPIO19 | SPI data back to the ESP32: chip ID and status |
| CSN | GPIO25 | SPI chip select: low while the ESP32 talks to the chip |
| GDO0 | GPIO26 | Send data: 3.3 V turns the 433 MHz carrier on, 0 V off |
| GDO2 | GPIO27 | Receive data: 3.3 V while the chip hears a carrier |

The four SPI wires only carry settings; the remote codes travel over GDO0
(sending) and GDO2 (receiving) as plain on/off pulses. On some modules MISO
is labelled GDO1.

Make sure the module is the 433 MHz version (the longer spring antenna;
868 MHz modules are often marked 8xx) and that the antenna is soldered on.

| VCC | 3.3V | Power |
| GND | GND | Ground |
| SCK | GPIO18 | SPI clock: timing for the settings link |
| MOSI | GPIO23 | SPI data from the ESP32: frequency, power, send/listen |
| MISO (SO, GDO1) | GPIO19 | SPI data back to the ESP32: chip ID and status |
| CSN | GPIO25 | SPI chip select: low while the ESP32 talks to the chip |
| GDO0 | GPIO26 | Send data: 3.3 V turns the 433 MHz carrier on, 0 V off |
| GDO2 | GPIO27 | Receive data: 3.3 V while the chip hears a carrier |

The four SPI wires only carry settings; the remote codes travel over GDO0
(sending) and GDO2 (receiving) as plain on/off pulses. On some modules MISO
is labelled GDO1.

Make sure the module is the 433 MHz version (the longer spring antenna;
868 MHz modules are often marked 8xx) and that the antenna is soldered on.

| --- | --- | --- |
| VCC | 3.3V | Power |
| GND | GND | Ground |
| SCK | GPIO18 | SPI clock: timing for the settings link |
| MOSI | GPIO23 | SPI data from the ESP32: frequency, power, send/listen |
| MISO (SO, GDO1) | GPIO19 | SPI data back to the ESP32: chip ID and status |
| CSN | GPIO25 | SPI chip select: low while the ESP32 talks to the chip |
| GDO0 | GPIO26 | Send data: 3.3 V turns the 433 MHz carrier on, 0 V off |
| GDO2 | GPIO27 | Receive data: 3.3 V while the chip hears a carrier |

The four SPI wires only carry settings; the remote codes travel over GDO0
(sending) and GDO2 (receiving) as plain on/off pulses. On some modules MISO
is labelled GDO1.

Make sure the module is the 433 MHz version (the longer spring antenna;
868 MHz modules are often marked 8xx) and that the antenna is soldered on.

g| CC1101 | ESP32 | Function |
| --- | --- | --- |
| VCC | 3.3V | Power |
| GND | GND | Ground |
| SCK | GPIO18 | SPI clock: timing for the settings link |
| MOSI | GPIO23 | SPI data from the ESP32: frequency, power, send/listen |
| MISO (SO, GDO1) | GPIO19 | SPI data back to the ESP32: chip ID and status |
| CSN | GPIO25 | SPI chip select: low while the ESP32 talks to the chip |
| GDO0 | GPIO26 | Send data: 3.3 V turns the 433 MHz carrier on, 0 V off |
| GDO2 | GPIO27 | Receive data: 3.3 V while the chip hears a carrier |

The four SPI wires only carry settings; the remote codes travel over GDO0

is labelled GDO1.

Make sure the module is the 433 MHz version (the longer spring antenna;
868 MHz modules are often marked 8xx) and that the antenna is soldered on.

(sending) and GDO2 (receiving) as plain on/off pulses. On some modules MISO
is labelled GDO1.

Make sure the module is the 433 MHz version (the longer spring antenna;
868 MHz modules are often marked 8xx) and that the antenna is soldered on.

| GDO2 | GPIO27 | Receive data: 3.3 V while the chip hears a carrier |

The four SPI wires only carry settings; the remote codes travel over GDO0
(sending) and GDO2 (receiving) as plain on/off pulses. On some modules MISO
is labelled GDO1.

Make sure the module is the 433 MHz version (the longer spring antenna;
868 MHz modules are often marked 8xx) and that the antenna is soldered on.

| CSN | GPIO25 | SPI chip select: low while the ESP32 talks to the chip |
| GDO0 | GPIO26 | Send data: 3.3 V turns the 433 MHz carrier on, 0 V off |
| GDO2 | GPIO27 | Receive data: 3.3 V while the chip hears a carrier |

The four SPI wires only carry settings; the remote codes travel over GDO0
(sending) and GDO2 (receiving) as plain on/off pulses. On some modules MISO
is labelled GDO1.

Make sure the module is the 433 MHz version (the longer spring antenna;
868 MHz modules are often marked 8xx) and that the antenna is soldered on.

| MOSI | GPIO23 | SPI data from the ESP32: frequency, power, send/listen |
| MISO (SO, GDO1) | GPIO19 | SPI data back to the ESP32: chip ID and status |
| CSN | GPIO25 | SPI chip select: low while the ESP32 talks to the chip |
| GDO0 | GPIO26 | Send data: 3.3 V turns the 433 MHz carrier on, 0 V off |
| GDO2 | GPIO27 | Receive data: 3.3 V while the chip hears a carrier |

The four SPI wires only carry settings; the remote codes travel over GDO0
(sending) and GDO2 (receiving) as plain on/off pulses. On some modules MISO
is labelled GDO1.

Make sure the module is the 433 MHz version (the longer spring antenna;
868 MHz modules are often marked 8xx) and that the antenna is soldered on.

| SCK | GPIO18 | SPI clock: timing for the settings link |
| MOSI | GPIO23 | SPI data from the ESP32: frequency, power, send/listen |
| MISO (SO, GDO1) | GPIO19 | SPI data back to the ESP32: chip ID and status |
| CSN | GPIO25 | SPI chip select: low while the ESP32 talks to the chip |
| GDO0 | GPIO26 | Send data: 3.3 V turns the 433 MHz carrier on, 0 V off |
| GDO2 | GPIO27 | Receive data: 3.3 V while the chip hears a carrier |

The four SPI wires only carry settings; the remote codes travel over GDO0
(sending) and GDO2 (receiving) as plain on/off pulses. On some modules MISO
is labelled GDO1.

Make sure the module is the 433 MHz version (the longer spring antenna;
868 MHz modules are often marked 8xx) and that the antenna is soldered on.

| GND | GND | Ground |
| SCK | GPIO18 | SPI clock: timing for the settings link |
| MOSI | GPIO23 | SPI data from the ESP32: frequency, power, send/listen |
| MISO (SO, GDO1) | GPIO19 | SPI data back to the ESP32: chip ID and status |
| CSN | GPIO25 | SPI chip select: low while the ESP32 talks to the chip |
| GDO0 | GPIO26 | Send data: 3.3 V turns the 433 MHz carrier on, 0 V off |
| GDO2 | GPIO27 | Receive data: 3.3 V while the chip hears a carrier |

The four SPI wires only carry settings; the remote codes travel over GDO0
(sending) and GDO2 (receiving) as plain on/off pulses. On some modules MISO
is labelled GDO1.

Make sure the module is the 433 MHz version (the longer spring antenna;
868 MHz modules are often marked 8xx) and that the antenna is soldered on.

| VCC | 3.3V | Power |
| GND | GND | Ground |
| SCK | GPIO18 | SPI clock: timing for the settings link |
| MOSI | GPIO23 | SPI data from the ESP32: frequency, power, send/listen |
| MISO (SO, GDO1) | GPIO19 | SPI data back to the ESP32: chip ID and status |
| CSN | GPIO25 | SPI chip select: low while the ESP32 talks to the chip |
| GDO0 | GPIO26 | Send data: 3.3 V turns the 433 MHz carrier on, 0 V off |
| GDO2 | GPIO27 | Receive data: 3.3 V while the chip hears a carrier |

The four SPI wires only carry settings; the remote codes travel over GDO0
(sending) and GDO2 (receiving) as plain on/off pulses. On some modules MISO
is labelled GDO1.

Make sure the module is the 433 MHz version (the longer spring antenna;
868 MHz modules are often marked 8xx) and that the antenna is soldered on.

| --- | --- | --- |
| VCC | 3.3V | Power |
| GND | GND | Ground |
| SCK | GPIO18 | SPI clock: timing for the settings link |
| MOSI | GPIO23 | SPI data from the ESP32: frequency, power, send/listen |
| MISO (SO, GDO1) | GPIO19 | SPI data back to the ESP32: chip ID and status |
| CSN | GPIO25 | SPI chip select: low while the ESP32 talks to the chip |
| GDO0 | GPIO26 | Send data: 3.3 V turns the 433 MHz carrier on, 0 V off |
| GDO2 | GPIO27 | Receive data: 3.3 V while the chip hears a carrier |

The four SPI wires only carry settings; the remote codes travel over GDO0
(sending) and GDO2 (receiving) as plain on/off pulses. On some modules MISO
is labelled GDO1.

Make sure the module is the 433 MHz version (the longer spring antenna;
868 MHz modules are often marked 8xx) and that the antenna is soldered on.

| GND | GND | Ground |

(sending) and GDO2 (receiving) as plain on/off pulses. On some modules MISO
is labelled GDO1.

Make sure the module is the 433 MHz version (the longer spring antenna;
868 MHz modules are often marked 8xx) and that the antenna is soldered on.

| GDO2 | GPIO27 | Receive data: 3.3 V while the chip hears a carrier |

The four SPI wires only carry settings; the remote codes travel over GDO0
(sending) and GDO2 (receiving) as plain on/off pulses. On some modules MISO
is labelled GDO1.

Make sure the module is the 433 MHz version (the longer spring antenna;
868 MHz modules are often marked 8xx) and that the antenna is soldered on.

| CSN | GPIO25 | SPI chip select: low while the ESP32 talks to the chip |
| GDO0 | GPIO26 | Send data: 3.3 V turns the 433 MHz carrier on, 0 V off |
| GDO2 | GPIO27 | Receive data: 3.3 V while the chip hears a carrier |

The four SPI wires only carry settings; the remote codes travel over GDO0
(sending) and GDO2 (receiving) as plain on/off pulses. On some modules MISO
is labelled GDO1.

Make sure the module is the 433 MHz version (the longer spring antenna;
868 MHz modules are often marked 8xx) and that the antenna is soldered on.

| MOSI | GPIO23 | SPI data from the ESP32: frequency, power, send/listen |
| MISO (SO, GDO1) | GPIO19 | SPI data back to the ESP32: chip ID and status |
| CSN | GPIO25 | SPI chip select: low while the ESP32 talks to the chip |
| GDO0 | GPIO26 | Send data: 3.3 V turns the 433 MHz carrier on, 0 V off |
| GDO2 | GPIO27 | Receive data: 3.3 V while the chip hears a carrier |

The four SPI wires only carry settings; the remote codes travel over GDO0
(sending) and GDO2 (receiving) as plain on/off pulses. On some modules MISO
is labelled GDO1.

Make sure the module is the 433 MHz version (the longer spring antenna;
868 MHz modules are often marked 8xx) and that the antenna is soldered on.

| SCK | GPIO18 | SPI clock: timing for the settings link |
| MOSI | GPIO23 | SPI data from the ESP32: frequency, power, send/listen |
| MISO (SO, GDO1) | GPIO19 | SPI data back to the ESP32: chip ID and status |
| CSN | GPIO25 | SPI chip select: low while the ESP32 talks to the chip |
| GDO0 | GPIO26 | Send data: 3.3 V turns the 433 MHz carrier on, 0 V off |
| GDO2 | GPIO27 | Receive data: 3.3 V while the chip hears a carrier |

The four SPI wires only carry settings; the remote codes travel over GDO0
(sending) and GDO2 (receiving) as plain on/off pulses. On some modules MISO
is labelled GDO1.

Make sure the module is the 433 MHz version (the longer spring antenna;
868 MHz modules are often marked 8xx) and that the antenna is soldered on.

| GND | GND | Ground |
| SCK | GPIO18 | SPI clock: timing for the settings link |
| MOSI | GPIO23 | SPI data from the ESP32: frequency, power, send/listen |
| MISO (SO, GDO1) | GPIO19 | SPI data back to the ESP32: chip ID and status |
| CSN | GPIO25 | SPI chip select: low while the ESP32 talks to the chip |
| GDO0 | GPIO26 | Send data: 3.3 V turns the 433 MHz carrier on, 0 V off |
| GDO2 | GPIO27 | Receive data: 3.3 V while the chip hears a carrier |

The four SPI wires only carry settings; the remote codes travel over GDO0
(sending) and GDO2 (receiving) as plain on/off pulses. On some modules MISO
is labelled GDO1.

Make sure the module is the 433 MHz version (the longer spring antenna;
868 MHz modules are often marked 8xx) and that the antenna is soldered on.

| VCC | 3.3V | Power |
| GND | GND | Ground |
| SCK | GPIO18 | SPI clock: timing for the settings link |
| MOSI | GPIO23 | SPI data from the ESP32: frequency, power, send/listen |
| MISO (SO, GDO1) | GPIO19 | SPI data back to the ESP32: chip ID and status |
| CSN | GPIO25 | SPI chip select: low while the ESP32 talks to the chip |
| GDO0 | GPIO26 | Send data: 3.3 V turns the 433 MHz carrier on, 0 V off |
| GDO2 | GPIO27 | Receive data: 3.3 V while the chip hears a carrier |

The four SPI wires only carry settings; the remote codes travel over GDO0
(sending) and GDO2 (receiving) as plain on/off pulses. On some modules MISO
is labelled GDO1.

Make sure the module is the 433 MHz version (the longer spring antenna;
868 MHz modules are often marked 8xx) and that the antenna is soldered on.

| --- | --- | --- |
| VCC | 3.3V | Power |
| GND | GND | Ground |
| SCK | GPIO18 | SPI clock: timing for the settings link |
| MOSI | GPIO23 | SPI data from the ESP32: frequency, power, send/listen |
| MISO (SO, GDO1) | GPIO19 | SPI data back to the ESP32: chip ID and status |
| CSN | GPIO25 | SPI chip select: low while the ESP32 talks to the chip |
| GDO0 | GPIO26 | Send data: 3.3 V turns the 433 MHz carrier on, 0 V off |
| GDO2 | GPIO27 | Receive data: 3.3 V while the chip hears a carrier |

The four SPI wires only carry settings; the remote codes travel over GDO0
(sending) and GDO2 (receiving) as plain on/off pulses. On some modules MISO
is labelled GDO1.

Make sure the module is the 433 MHz version (the longer spring antenna;
868 MHz modules are often marked 8xx) and that the antenna is soldered on.

| GND | GND | Ground |

(sending) and GDO2 (receiving) as plain on/off pulses. On some modules MISO
is labelled GDO1.

Make sure the module is the 433 MHz version (the longer spring antenna;
868 MHz modules are often marked 8xx) and that the antenna is soldered on.

| GDO2 | GPIO27 | Receive data: 3.3 V while the chip hears a carrier |

The four SPI wires only carry settings; the remote codes travel over GDO0
(sending) and GDO2 (receiving) as plain on/off pulses. On some modules MISO
is labelled GDO1.

Make sure the module is the 433 MHz version (the longer spring antenna;
868 MHz modules are often marked 8xx) and that the antenna is soldered on.

| CSN | GPIO25 | SPI chip select: low while the ESP32 talks to the chip |
| GDO0 | GPIO26 | Send data: 3.3 V turns the 433 MHz carrier on, 0 V off |
| GDO2 | GPIO27 | Receive data: 3.3 V while the chip hears a carrier |

The four SPI wires only carry settings; the remote codes travel over GDO0
(sending) and GDO2 (receiving) as plain on/off pulses. On some modules MISO
is labelled GDO1.

Make sure the module is the 433 MHz version (the longer spring antenna;
868 MHz modules are often marked 8xx) and that the antenna is soldered on.

| MOSI | GPIO23 | SPI data from the ESP32: frequency, power, send/listen |
| MISO (SO, GDO1) | GPIO19 | SPI data back to the ESP32: chip ID and status |
| CSN | GPIO25 | SPI chip select: low while the ESP32 talks to the chip |
| GDO0 | GPIO26 | Send data: 3.3 V turns the 433 MHz carrier on, 0 V off |
| GDO2 | GPIO27 | Receive data: 3.3 V while the chip hears a carrier |

The four SPI wires only carry settings; the remote codes travel over GDO0
(sending) and GDO2 (receiving) as plain on/off pulses. On some modules MISO
is labelled GDO1.

Make sure the module is the 433 MHz version (the longer spring antenna;
868 MHz modules are often marked 8xx) and that the antenna is soldered on.

| SCK | GPIO18 | SPI clock: timing for the settings link |
| MOSI | GPIO23 | SPI data from the ESP32: frequency, power, send/listen |
| MISO (SO, GDO1) | GPIO19 | SPI data back to the ESP32: chip ID and status |
| CSN | GPIO25 | SPI chip select: low while the ESP32 talks to the chip |
| GDO0 | GPIO26 | Send data: 3.3 V turns the 433 MHz carrier on, 0 V off |
| GDO2 | GPIO27 | Receive data: 3.3 V while the chip hears a carrier |

The four SPI wires only carry settings; the remote codes travel over GDO0
(sending) and GDO2 (receiving) as plain on/off pulses. On some modules MISO
is labelled GDO1.

Make sure the module is the 433 MHz version (the longer spring antenna;
868 MHz modules are often marked 8xx) and that the antenna is soldered on.

| GND | GND | Ground |
| SCK | GPIO18 | SPI clock: timing for the settings link |
| MOSI | GPIO23 | SPI data from the ESP32: frequency, power, send/listen |
| MISO (SO, GDO1) | GPIO19 | SPI data back to the ESP32: chip ID and status |
| CSN | GPIO25 | SPI chip select: low while the ESP32 talks to the chip |
| GDO0 | GPIO26 | Send data: 3.3 V turns the 433 MHz carrier on, 0 V off |
| GDO2 | GPIO27 | Receive data: 3.3 V while the chip hears a carrier |

The four SPI wires only carry settings; the remote codes travel over GDO0
(sending) and GDO2 (receiving) as plain on/off pulses. On some modules MISO
is labelled GDO1.

Make sure the module is the 433 MHz version (the longer spring antenna;
868 MHz modules are often marked 8xx) and that the antenna is soldered on.

| VCC | 3.3V | Power |
| GND | GND | Ground |
| SCK | GPIO18 | SPI clock: timing for the settings link |
| MOSI | GPIO23 | SPI data from the ESP32: frequency, power, send/listen |
| MISO (SO, GDO1) | GPIO19 | SPI data back to the ESP32: chip ID and status |
| CSN | GPIO25 | SPI chip select: low while the ESP32 talks to the chip |
| GDO0 | GPIO26 | Send data: 3.3 V turns the 433 MHz carrier on, 0 V off |
| GDO2 | GPIO27 | Receive data: 3.3 V while the chip hears a carrier |

The four SPI wires only carry settings; the remote codes travel over GDO0
(sending) and GDO2 (receiving) as plain on/off pulses. On some modules MISO
is labelled GDO1.

Make sure the module is the 433 MHz version (the longer spring antenna;
868 MHz modules are often marked 8xx) and that the antenna is soldered on.

| --- | --- | --- |
| VCC | 3.3V | Power |
| GND | GND | Ground |
| SCK | GPIO18 | SPI clock: timing for the settings link |
| MOSI | GPIO23 | SPI data from the ESP32: frequency, power, send/listen |
| MISO (SO, GDO1) | GPIO19 | SPI data back to the ESP32: chip ID and status |
| CSN | GPIO25 | SPI chip select: low while the ESP32 talks to the chip |
| GDO0 | GPIO26 | Send data: 3.3 V turns the 433 MHz carrier on, 0 V off |
| GDO2 | GPIO27 | Receive data: 3.3 V while the chip hears a carrier |

The four SPI wires only carry settings; the remote codes travel over GDO0
(sending) and GDO2 (receiving) as plain on/off pulses. On some modules MISO
is labelled GDO1.

Make sure the module is the 433 MHz version (the longer spring antenna;
868 MHz modules are often marked 8xx) and that the antenna is soldered on.

`| CC1101 | ESP32 | Function |
| --- | --- | --- |
| VCC | 3.3V | Power |
| GND | GND | Ground |
| SCK | GPIO18 | SPI clock: timing for the settings link |
| MOSI | GPIO23 | SPI data from the ESP32: frequency, power, send/listen |
| MISO (SO, GDO1) | GPIO19 | SPI data back to the ESP32: chip ID and status |
| CSN | GPIO25 | SPI chip select: low while the ESP32 talks to the chip |
| GDO0 | GPIO26 | Send data: 3.3 V turns the 433 MHz carrier on, 0 V off |
| GDO2 | GPIO27 | Receive data: 3.3 V while the chip hears a carrier |

(sending) and GDO2 (receiving) as plain on/off pulses. On some modules MISO
is labelled GDO1.

Make sure the module is the 433 MHz version (the longer spring antenna;
868 MHz modules are often marked 8xx) and that the antenna is soldered on.

(sending) and GDO2 (receiving) as plain on/off pulses. On some modules MISO
is labelled GDO1.

Make sure the module is the 433 MHz version (the longer spring antenna;
868 MHz modules are often marked 8xx) and that the antenna is soldered on.

| GDO2 | GPIO27 | Receive data: 3.3 V while the chip hears a carrier |

The four SPI wires only carry settings; the remote codes travel over GDO0
(sending) and GDO2 (receiving) as plain on/off pulses. On some modules MISO
is labelled GDO1.

Make sure the module is the 433 MHz version (the longer spring antenna;
868 MHz modules are often marked 8xx) and that the antenna is soldered on.

| CSN | GPIO25 | SPI chip select: low while the ESP32 talks to the chip |
| GDO0 | GPIO26 | Send data: 3.3 V turns the 433 MHz carrier on, 0 V off |
| GDO2 | GPIO27 | Receive data: 3.3 V while the chip hears a carrier |

The four SPI wires only carry settings; the remote codes travel over GDO0
(sending) and GDO2 (receiving) as plain on/off pulses. On some modules MISO
is labelled GDO1.

Make sure the module is the 433 MHz version (the longer spring antenna;
868 MHz modules are often marked 8xx) and that the antenna is soldered on.

| MOSI | GPIO23 | SPI data from the ESP32: frequency, power, send/listen |
| MISO (SO, GDO1) | GPIO19 | SPI data back to the ESP32: chip ID and status |
| CSN | GPIO25 | SPI chip select: low while the ESP32 talks to the chip |
| GDO0 | GPIO26 | Send data: 3.3 V turns the 433 MHz carrier on, 0 V off |
| GDO2 | GPIO27 | Receive data: 3.3 V while the chip hears a carrier |

The four SPI wires only carry settings; the remote codes travel over GDO0
(sending) and GDO2 (receiving) as plain on/off pulses. On some modules MISO
is labelled GDO1.

Make sure the module is the 433 MHz version (the longer spring antenna;
868 MHz modules are often marked 8xx) and that the antenna is soldered on.

| SCK | GPIO18 | SPI clock: timing for the settings link |
| MOSI | GPIO23 | SPI data from the ESP32: frequency, power, send/listen |
| MISO (SO, GDO1) | GPIO19 | SPI data back to the ESP32: chip ID and status |
| CSN | GPIO25 | SPI chip select: low while the ESP32 talks to the chip |
| GDO0 | GPIO26 | Send data: 3.3 V turns the 433 MHz carrier on, 0 V off |
| GDO2 | GPIO27 | Receive data: 3.3 V while the chip hears a carrier |

The four SPI wires only carry settings; the remote codes travel over GDO0
(sending) and GDO2 (receiving) as plain on/off pulses. On some modules MISO
is labelled GDO1.

Make sure the module is the 433 MHz version (the longer spring antenna;
868 MHz modules are often marked 8xx) and that the antenna is soldered on.

| GND | GND | Ground |
| SCK | GPIO18 | SPI clock: timing for the settings link |
| MOSI | GPIO23 | SPI data from the ESP32: frequency, power, send/listen |
| MISO (SO, GDO1) | GPIO19 | SPI data back to the ESP32: chip ID and status |
| CSN | GPIO25 | SPI chip select: low while the ESP32 talks to the chip |
| GDO0 | GPIO26 | Send data: 3.3 V turns the 433 MHz carrier on, 0 V off |
| GDO2 | GPIO27 | Receive data: 3.3 V while the chip hears a carrier |

The four SPI wires only carry settings; the remote codes travel over GDO0
(sending) and GDO2 (receiving) as plain on/off pulses. On some modules MISO
is labelled GDO1.

Make sure the module is the 433 MHz version (the longer spring antenna;
868 MHz modules are often marked 8xx) and that the antenna is soldered on.

| VCC | 3.3V | Power |
| GND | GND | Ground |
| SCK | GPIO18 | SPI clock: timing for the settings link |
| MOSI | GPIO23 | SPI data from the ESP32: frequency, power, send/listen |
| MISO (SO, GDO1) | GPIO19 | SPI data back to the ESP32: chip ID and status |
| CSN | GPIO25 | SPI chip select: low while the ESP32 talks to the chip |
| GDO0 | GPIO26 | Send data: 3.3 V turns the 433 MHz carrier on, 0 V off |
| GDO2 | GPIO27 | Receive data: 3.3 V while the chip hears a carrier |

The four SPI wires only carry settings; the remote codes travel over GDO0
(sending) and GDO2 (receiving) as plain on/off pulses. On some modules MISO
is labelled GDO1.

Make sure the module is the 433 MHz version (the longer spring antenna;
868 MHz modules are often marked 8xx) and that the antenna is soldered on.

| --- | --- | --- |
| VCC | 3.3V | Power |
| GND | GND | Ground |
| SCK | GPIO18 | SPI clock: timing for the settings link |
| MOSI | GPIO23 | SPI data from the ESP32: frequency, power, send/listen |
| MISO (SO, GDO1) | GPIO19 | SPI data back to the ESP32: chip ID and status |
| CSN | GPIO25 | SPI chip select: low while the ESP32 talks to the chip |
| GDO0 | GPIO26 | Send data: 3.3 V turns the 433 MHz carrier on, 0 V off |
| GDO2 | GPIO27 | Receive data: 3.3 V while the chip hears a carrier |

The four SPI wires only carry settings; the remote codes travel over GDO0
(sending) and GDO2 (receiving) as plain on/off pulses. On some modules MISO
is labelled GDO1.

Make sure the module is the 433 MHz version (the longer spring antenna;
868 MHz modules are often marked 8xx) and that the antenna is soldered on.

H| CC1101 | ESP32 | Function |
| --- | --- | --- |
| VCC | 3.3V | Power |
| GND | GND | Ground |
| SCK | GPIO18 | SPI clock: timing for the settings link |
| MOSI | GPIO23 | SPI data from the ESP32: frequency, power, send/listen |
| MISO (SO, GDO1) | GPIO19 | SPI data back to the ESP32: chip ID and status |

868 MHz modules are often marked 8xx) and that the antenna is soldered on.

(sending) and GDO2 (receiving) as plain on/off pulses. On some modules MISO
is labelled GDO1.

Make sure the module is the 433 MHz version (the longer spring antenna;
868 MHz modules are often marked 8xx) and that the antenna is soldered on.

| GDO2 | GPIO27 | Receive data: 3.3 V while the chip hears a carrier |

The four SPI wires only carry settings; the remote codes travel over GDO0
(sending) and GDO2 (receiving) as plain on/off pulses. On some modules MISO
is labelled GDO1.

Make sure the module is the 433 MHz version (the longer spring antenna;
868 MHz modules are often marked 8xx) and that the antenna is soldered on.

| CSN | GPIO25 | SPI chip select: low while the ESP32 talks to the chip |
| GDO0 | GPIO26 | Send data: 3.3 V turns the 433 MHz carrier on, 0 V off |
| GDO2 | GPIO27 | Receive data: 3.3 V while the chip hears a carrier |

The four SPI wires only carry settings; the remote codes travel over GDO0
(sending) and GDO2 (receiving) as plain on/off pulses. On some modules MISO
is labelled GDO1.

Make sure the module is the 433 MHz version (the longer spring antenna;
868 MHz modules are often marked 8xx) and that the antenna is soldered on.

| MOSI | GPIO23 | SPI data from the ESP32: frequency, power, send/listen |
| MISO (SO, GDO1) | GPIO19 | SPI data back to the ESP32: chip ID and status |
| CSN | GPIO25 | SPI chip select: low while the ESP32 talks to the chip |
| GDO0 | GPIO26 | Send data: 3.3 V turns the 433 MHz carrier on, 0 V off |
| GDO2 | GPIO27 | Receive data: 3.3 V while the chip hears a carrier |

The four SPI wires only carry settings; the remote codes travel over GDO0
(sending) and GDO2 (receiving) as plain on/off pulses. On some modules MISO
is labelled GDO1.

Make sure the module is the 433 MHz version (the longer spring antenna;
868 MHz modules are often marked 8xx) and that the antenna is soldered on.
